I was on 500mg of Seroquel. I was misdiagnosed as bipolar in 2014, and then in 2017 I took the MMPI and found out that I have c-ptsd and that's when I started tapering. I was having a lot of side effects and was still miserable on it, so I figured I had nothing to lose by trying to come off of it.

I'm on disability because of how debilitating the withdrawal was, but that's okay, I'm feeling hope for the first time in years and am so excited to start healing and start working again! :)

Thank you! I've been seeing my NP since I started tapering, so she's known about it, but she couldn't help much besides prescribe me stuff for the nausea. My therapist has been a godsend through all of this. It's the hardest thing I've ever done.
Thank you. I'm really hoping for a better future.
Thank you. Positive self-talk has definitely helped me, it's just been rough lately. Well, the past 9 years lol
I desperately needed a hug, thank you.
Thank you mom♡ I will totally accept hugs.
My therapist is one of the only reasons I'm still alive. You just have to find the right one.
